subject: general
question: A Sravan leaves point Y and travels 5 km towards north. Then he turned right, walked 5 km, turned right and walked 7 km. Then he turned right and walked 15 km. Then he turned right and walked 2 km. Finally he turns right, travels 5 km and stops at point M. In which direction and how far must he travel from point M to point Y? (All rotations are only 90 degree rotations.)
solution:
**Given: **

A Sravan leaves point Y and travels 5 km towards the north.

Then he turned right, walked 5 km, turned right and walked 7 km.

Then he turned right and walked 15 km.

Then he turned right and walked 2 km.

Finally, he turns right, travels 5 km and stops at point M. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd9e98068dd931c5f557889750a9b7a383d8e36a58b9d075fd7cd2332ba4362.png] 

Thus, Sravan must travel (15 km - 5 km - 5 km) 5 km from point M to point Y in the east direction.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
